title: NBA Sim FSM Transition Table (foundation 0.1.0)
description: Closed set of phases plus the full (from, trigger) -> to transition table for v0.1.0. The phases array is fixed at 15 entries; adding or removing a phase requires a foundation_version bump per docs/foundation/README.md semver policy. The transition rows are the structural enforcement of the FSM; the narrative rules live in docs/foundation/fsm.md.

foundation_version.description: Semver stamp of the FSM contract. Must match config/foundation.json#foundation_version.

phases.description: Closed set of FSM phases for v0.1.0. The min/max Items pair pins the count; uniqueItems rejects duplicates; the $defs/phaseName enum rejects unknown values. Adding a phase requires bumping foundation_version and updating both bounds.

transitions.$comment: The lower bound of 20 is the documented minimum coverage (every DEAD_* exit + period router branches). The actual v0.1.0 freeze ships 28 rows. Uniqueness of (from, trigger) pairs is enforced by scripts/check-foundation.mjs (todo 9 linter) - JSON Schema draft-07 has no portable keyword for cross-item composite uniqueness in ajv-cli strict mode (same precedent as event-catalog.schema.json).

phaseName.description: Authoritative phase enum for v0.1.0. MUST stay in sync with the phases array in this same document; the T9 linter (scripts/check-foundation.mjs) is the cross-check.

trigger.description: UPPER_SNAKE_CASE trigger name. Triggers are FSM-internal (not EventTypes); they name the input that fires the transition.

emit_events.description: EventTypes emitted when this transition fires. Cross-reference against config/event-catalog.json is enforced by scripts/check-foundation.mjs (todo 9 linter) - the schema pins the UPPER_SNAKE shape only. The same precedent (deferred cross-file enum check) is used in event-catalog.schema.json and duration.schema.json.

notes.description: Short human-readable description of when the transition fires.

regulation_total.description: Total team timeouts allowed across Q1-Q4 in regulation. Pinned to 7 (NBA modern rule).

max_in_q4.description: Maximum number of regulation timeouts a team may carry into Q4. Pinned to 4 (NBA modern rule).

overtime_total.description: Total team timeouts allowed per overtime period. Pinned to 2 (NBA modern rule).

legal_phases.description: Phases in which a SUB event may legally fire.

illegal_phases.description: Phases in which a SUB event is a kernel error (IllegalPhaseError).

notes.description: Free-form clarification of substitution legality rules, including the FT_SEQUENCE sub rule.

substitutionLegality.$comment: Two cross-property invariants are NOT expressible in JSON Schema draft-07 under ajv-cli strict mode and are enforced by scripts/check-foundation.mjs (todo 9 linter): (1) legal_phases and illegal_phases must be disjoint; (2) their union must equal the phases array (every phase classified). The linter also checks that FT_SEQUENCE appears in illegal_phases (mid-FT subs are illegal by default) since the doc states the only legal FT_SEQUENCE sub windows are pre-first-FT and post-FT_SEQUENCE_END, which the FSM represents as transitions out of FT_SEQUENCE, not as subs inside it.
